disclaimer: This supplemental file is independent editorial evidence. A verified NBA ID/team or specific season metric does NOT certify six skills, current exact starter-slot eligibility, or the entire 330-player cohort. Current team differs from 2025-26 team for some players. Six focused candidate-slot corrections use historical position evidence but do not constitute fully verified 2026–27 playable-position eligibility. Four absent 2025–26 veterans now have verified no-season status and last played 2024–25 NBA production; these are separate from the 2025–26 numeric-source census. Four further slot misclassifications individually adjudicated, each still held as a provisional eligible-position lead. Additional October 30 12-person 2025-26 no-NBA-season partition includes eight 2026 draft players, one undrafted two-way college graduate, a 2025 injured NBA rookie, and two Europe returnees; this classification does not increase numerical NBA-season sources or full certification.

individualResearch.name: Jaden McDaniels
individualResearch.decision: Apply cautious shooting increase: 250 three-point attempts and 41.2% over 73 games materially exceed previous 76 projection; do not grade like a high-volume specialist; one-year improvement can regress.
individualResearch.comparison: Below Luke Kennard 95 specialist anchor; below Cam Spencer 90; 81 above-average wing shooting is supported by 3.4 3PA without pretending high difficulty was established.

individualResearch.name: Bub Carrington
individualResearch.decision: Apply shooting adjustment for full 82-game 40.8% on 5.0 attempts per game; broader shot mix and pull-up difficulty remain unverified.
individualResearch.comparison: Higher volume than Jaden McDaniels (5.0 vs 3.4 3PA); below top specialists and not a conversion from 3P% into grade.

individualResearch.name: Josh Hart
individualResearch.decision: Cautious 73→77: 100/242 3PT (41.3%) in 2025–26 vs 84/252 (33.3%) in 2024–25 and 31.0% in 2023–24; predominantly lower-difficulty created-for-him attempts and multi-year volatility mean do not jump to 80+. Overall and other five attributes unchanged.
individualResearch.comparison: Below Jaden McDaniels 81 provisional shotmaking; comparable wing volume but lower multi-season confidence; not 85+ specialist.

individualResearch.name: Oscar Tshiebwe
individualResearch.decision: Do not downgrade from 96 without context: Rockets' official release cites historically exceptional NBA per-36 offensive rebound rate and 16.9 G League RPG; 49 career NBA games at time of signing remains small exposure.

individualResearch.name: Cam Spencer
individualResearch.decision: Apply cautious playmaking correction after 72 regular-season NBA games: 5.6 assists vs 1.3 turnovers in 23.8 minutes, 33.1 AST%, and 17.2 USG%. This is strong measured creation/decision-making for a role guard but not elite lead-guard burden. Retain 79 overall and all other traits; defensive/playmaking film still pending.
individualResearch.comparison: Above current 74 below-average grade; 80 above-average but below Immanuel Quickley and primary-creator elite anchors. Not derived from 5.6 APG alone.

individualResearch.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
individualResearch.decision: Add previously absent individually sourced 2025-26 context. Stats belong to Milwaukee season, 2026-27 Miami is separately verified; 36 games limit certainty. This does not establish all six skill grades.

individualResearch.name: Tyrese Haliburton
individualResearch.decision: Document actual no-season NBA sample (Achilles absence), not zero basketball ability. Review healthy 2024-25 season and 2026-27 short return separately; do not mechanically penalize his 96 playmaking.

individualResearch.name: Jaden McDaniels
individualResearch.decision: Prior-year baseline corroborates rebound in three-point shooting rather than assuming lifetime 41.2% talent.

individualResearch.name: Collin Sexton
individualResearch.decision: Apply measured shooting correction: 40.1% on 279 threes in 68 regular-season NBA games plus 85.5% FT; 4.1 3PA per game reflects real but sub-specialist shot volume. Historical shooting and on/off-ball difficulty remain review questions, so use 82, not 90.
individualResearch.comparison: Above 77 solid, below 90+ high-volume specialty shooters; compare Bub Carrington 82 (40.8% at 5 attempts) and Jaden McDaniels 81 (41.2% at 3.4 attempts).

individualResearch.name: Julian Strawther
individualResearch.decision: Reduce 85→82 provisional: 58/150 (38.7%) threes in 2025–26 after 94/269 (34.9%) in 2024–25; limited 15.1 MPG and career 193/557 (.346) do not independently demonstrate elite difficult movement shooting. Other five traits and overall unchanged.
individualResearch.comparison: Compared with Cam Spencer 90 and Luke Kennard 95 as high-certainty specialist gravity anchors; limited volume and weaker multi-year efficiency support 82 until film corroboration.

individualResearch.name: Peyton Watson
individualResearch.decision: 2025-26 81/197 threes (41.1%) over 54 games after 2024-25 48/136 (35.3%) and 2023-24 29.6%; 2.9 catch-and-shoot 3PA per game with 46.8% accuracy vs only ~0.7 pull-up 3PA. Raise 70→77 solid spacing rather than assuming high-difficulty specialist gravity from one improved season.
individualResearch.comparison: Above a 70 limited-shooter grade, below Andrew Wiggins and John Collins as more established shooting roles, and far below Luke Kennard 95. Shot variety and playoff defensive game-plan film still pending.

individualResearch.name: Kasparas Jakucionis
individualResearch.decision: 2025-26 Miami 66/156 3P (42.3%) in 53 games and 87.9% FT, contrasted with 2024-25 Illinois 31.8% 3P on 5.2 attempts/game and 84.5% FT. Raise 72→78 cautiously; 17.8 MPG and 2.9 NBA 3PA/game do not establish difficult-shot gravity or multi-year repeatability.
individualResearch.comparison: Near Josh Hart 77 as useful but unproven/variable spacer, below Jaden McDaniels 81 and Bub Carrington 82 with larger NBA samples, far below Luke Kennard 95.

individualResearch.name: John Collins
individualResearch.decision: 2025-26 89/219 (40.6%) threes over 69 games after 39.9% on 148 attempts in 2024-25 and 37.1% on 232 in 2023-24. Above-average stretch-four shooting is repeatedly demonstrated; 3.2 3PA/game and largely complementary floor spacing do not imply movement-shooter excellence.
individualResearch.comparison: Similar useful spacing tier to Andrew Wiggins 81 but lower volume/greater frontcourt catch-and-shoot role; above Peyton Watson 77 shorter track record; far below Kennard 95.

individualResearch.name: Andrew Wiggins
individualResearch.decision: 2025-26 138/333 (41.4%) NBA threes over 68 Miami games (4.9 3PA/game) after 2024-25 37.4% and 2023-24 35.8%; earlier 2021-23 roughly 39% seasons demonstrate real complementary wing shotmaking with multi-year variance. Raise 78→81, not to 85+ without pull-up/contested gravity evidence.
individualResearch.comparison: Higher volume and years of NBA evidence than Peyton Watson 77 or rookie Kasparas Jakucionis 78; similar level to John Collins 81 in different wing vs frontcourt shooting roles; below specialist Kennard 95.
